requirement: C05L-2026-EXP (owner audit Phase B, B6): exploratory league-constrained D/ST evaluation on completed 2026 weeks.
declaredAt: 2026-11-24, before any 2026 league-constrained result was computed (TASK-20261124-009)
classification: EXPLORATORY. Weeks 1-11 were observed before the prospective freeze, and these forecasts are reconstructed after the fact (RETROSPECTIVE). Never independent confirmation; never alters the frozen Phase B or Phase C rules.
forecasts: The frozen method through arbit_model.dvp.shadow (as the prospective harness): parameters fit on 2016-2025, each week forecast from the actuals available by its preweek cutoff. 2026 data: the season observations and schedule archived with the 2026 week-12 prospective forecast (artifacts/dvp/prospective/2026/week-12/inputs, hashes in its manifest), final revisions as held on 2026-11-24.
decisionTime: The week's preweek cutoff: its first scheduled kickoff, the forecasts' own cutoff.
ownership: arbit_model.ffa_history: the draft and every executed add and drop replayed to the decision time. Verified beforehand against every captured period roster (weeks 1-11) and every daily archived snapshot (2026-10-31 to 11-24). Current ownership is never used.
availability: On no roster at the decision time and not dropped within two waiver holds (48 hours) before it: FREE_AGENT, claimable at once until the unit's own game locks. Dropped within 24 hours: WAIVERS. Dropped 24-48 hours before: WAIVERS_OR_FREE_AGENT. Both waiver classes are excluded from free-agent streaming.

decisions.start: Roster-constrained: each FFA team holding two or more D/STs with a game that week. Each model starts its higher forecast; ties break by franchise code.
decisions.stream: Each FFA team: the highest forecast among its own D/STs with a game and the FREE_AGENT D/STs with a game. Evaluated separately from start.
decisions.streamIncludingWaivers: The same, also allowing WAIVERS and WAIVERS_OR_FREE_AGENT units: an upper bound, reported separately.

labels: Arbit's canonical FFA D/ST actuals (the same archived 2026 observations). ESPN's official D/ST points from the captured lineups are compared with them for rostered units as reconciliation evidence.
metrics: decisions and actionable coverage (decisions with at least two options, of team-weeks)
changed recommendations (B06 pick differs from B00)
points from changed recommendations: B06 pick's actual points minus B00's, total and per change
head-to-head accuracy on changed recommendations (B06 scored more 1, tie 0.5)
hit rate: the pick scored the most among its options (ties count)
regret: the best option's points minus the pick's, mean per decision, per model
managers' actual starts (start decisions): their regret and agreement with each model

matchup implications (start decisions): the team's official total with each model's pick in place of its started D/ST (ESPN official points), against the opponent's official total; results that differ between B00 and B06 picks
uncertainty: Week-block bootstrap of points from changed recommendations: 2,000 replicates, seed 1729. Descriptive.
